attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The derivation does not realize arbitrary semantic SAT pruning; RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb remains the named nonrelativizing bridge for full Psys_sym.
steps: Initialize K_pref from the final LB_N line; iteratively add ordinary parents, FormulaEval influences, and every earlier Qrep dictionary entry used by a reachable line.
For a quotient lookup r -> rep, add the lower-rank same-theory certificate forest and charge its row expansions in D_Qrep; append-only order makes the representative stable for all later lines.
Run the existing Gamma_bEF line induction with dictionary lookups replaced by charged representative circuits and certificate checks; no line reads an uncharged row.
If Gamma_pref is subthreshold, combine the generator circuit with the transcript circuit and sparse-row patching to obtain a same-model circuit for H_N, contradicting the asserted LB_N.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a restricted parser/countermodel theorem and Formula Footprints supporting lemma. It proves no H_N lower bound, no SAT lower bound, and no P != NP separation.

assumptions: Circuit model is nonuniform SIZE at source length N; generator G_N has size N^{rho+o(1)} and all row encodings are bit-explicit.
Every Qrep batch is append-only: no deletion, rebinding, or lookup before the batch rank and certificate forest are present in the transcript.
Ranked same-theory certificates are acyclic, dependency-closed, and charged once in D_Qrep(pi); equality is syntactic or proof-carrying, not semantic advice.
Full semantic branch pruning is quarantined; using it requires RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb with charged influence rows before the rule fires.
definitions: source object: H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)) with M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, beta=0 polylog SAT rows, and pi a Psys_sym^Qrep proof of LB_N(1+epsilon).
target object: same-model SIZE upper-bound falsifier for LB_N(1+epsilon), not a P vs NP or H_N lower-bound proof.
controlled interface: prefix-stable batched Qrep dictionary; each quotient lookup names an earlier batch entry, ranked same-theory certificate forest, and charged reachable support.
target-preserving condition: q,rho<1+epsilon, no hidden semantic SAT pruning, no advice-chosen representatives, and all FormulaEval/Qrep rows are surfaced before use.
K_pref(pi) is the least reachable support fixed point closed under proof parents, FormulaEval influences, Qrep dictionary entries, and lower-rank same-theory certificates.

equations.label: carrier
equations.valid_when: Valid when G_N is uniform and bit-explicit, M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, and queried SAT instances have polylog length so beta equals zero.

equations.label: prefix_ledger
equations.valid_when: Applies when every dictionary entry is appended before first use, certificate dependencies are lower rank, and row supports are influence closed.

equations.label: subthreshold_falsifier
equations.valid_when: Requires the target-preserving same-model SIZE simulation, q and rho below 1+epsilon, and no hidden semantic support or representative advice.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Reject the lemma if a legal proof can rebind, delete, or pre-use a representative without exposing a first private row whose flip changes the carrier while all charged rows agree.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Closes a temporal-mutation loophole in the Qrep dictionary patch and gives a finite verifier for the Formula Footprints supporting lemma.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Prefix-stable batched Qrep lemma: append-only ranked quotient dictionaries fold into TransparentRowSupport_N with ledger Gamma_pref; subthreshold Gamma_pref is a valid same-model LB_N falsifier, while the first temporal mutation gives a private-row countermodel.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot only if prefix stability cannot be locally verified from proof syntax or if a valid Qrep proof needs semantic rebindings not captured by RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote after the finite verifier checks append-only batches, rank decrease, dependency closure, charged certificates, and the first-bad-lookup falsifier proof.
control_decision.reason: This closes a real proof-audit loophole in the restricted TransparentRowSupport_N/Qrep module without broadening to new carriers or claiming P vs NP progress.

Full semantic branch pruning is not claimed. It remains quarantined unless RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb uniformly lists influence rows and charges R_N before the semantic rule is used.

Source statement, target statement, model, q/rho/epsilon regime, advice-free prefix dictionary condition, barrier status, and blocked semantic-realizer obligation are explicit for pvsnp-inference-quality review.

falsifiers: Prefix-use falsifier: a quotient lookup before its batch certificate is introduced leaves a private row uncharged; flip it while preserving all charged transcript rows.
Rebinding falsifier: if a representative map changes after use, two worlds agree on the old charged cone but differ on the later representative parity.
Rank-cycle falsifier: a nondecreasing or cyclic same-theory certificate lets a merge justify itself, so Gamma reduction is advice-like rather than valid proof-carrying compression.
Hidden-pruning falsifier: semantic branch selection that omits a counterfactual child is outside Qrep unless RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^arb lists and charges the missing row.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: Delta=0 gives the valid prefix ledger; any Delta>0 or rebinding permits a private-row two-world transcript agreeing on charged rows but disagreeing on H_N parity.
held_fixed_controls: Polylog SAT row length, so beta=0 is held fixed.
Same nonuniform SIZE model with q,rho<1+epsilon.
All declared same-theory certificates are ranked and charged.
No semantic SAT pruning outside the declared Qrep dictionary.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The proof packet needs a concrete falsifier probe for temporal dictionary leakage, not another abstract restatement of transparent support.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Use the beta-zero parity carrier with M_N=N^q rows and a Qrep batch that merges row a into representative b after line t, while an earlier line t-1 already uses b.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A prefix-stable dictionary verifier plus a first-bad-lookup private-row lemma before the intuition may enter the Gamma_pref line induction.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: Temporal lag Delta between first representative use and certified batch introduction, equivalently the number of post-use rebindings.
